title: Fair housing law to apply.
bodyText: Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, the provisions of chapter 515 shall apply in administering this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§201H-5]  Fair housing law to apply.  Notwithstanding any law to the contrary, the provisions of chapter 515 shall apply in administering this chapter. [L 2005, c 196, pt of §20]
